facts.value: Are you interested in biological sciences and wish to delve deeper? Would you like to understand how living things work, evolve and function at the molecular level? Do you want to prepare for a future where molecular biology will be at the coalface of human endeavour? Then this course might be for you.
Bachelor of Science in Industrial Biochemistry

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Industrial Biochemistry at UL?

facts.value: The B.Sc. In Industrial Biochemistry is a degree programme in biotechnology. It focuses upon the study of living cells (or components of living cells) and the medical/industrial applications of such substances. It is designed to prepare you for a career in the biotechnology sector and allied industries and has a very strong employment record.

facts.value: UL’s degree in Industrial Biochemistry provides students with brilliant hands-on laboratory experience, especially in Years 1–3. In Year 4, each student gets the opportunity to complete an individual research project and gets to choose from a wide range of interesting elective modules. This is a great opportunity to take ownership of your degree and it allows everyone to learn about topics that interest them most.
